pageDescription: FAS 4x4 Expedition Vehicles – Compact off-road vehicles for demanding adventures. Individual configurations from €189,000.

hero.title: 4x4 Systems
hero.subtitle: Compact, nimble, and trail-ready – the agile platform for demanding expeditions.

overview.description: Our 4x4 platform offers the perfect balance of agility and off-road capability. Based on proven chassis with permanent all-wheel drive, locking differentials, and low-range transfer case, these vehicles master every terrain. The modular design enables custom configurations for expeditions, rescue missions, or mobile workplaces.

features.title: Off-Road Capability
features.description: Permanent all-wheel drive with locking differentials and low-range transfer case for maximum traction in every terrain.

features.title: Modular Design
features.description: Interchangeable living and work modules for flexible configuration according to mission requirements.

features.title: Protection Packages
features.description: Optional ballistic protection packages up to VR7 for operations in conflict zones and unsafe regions.

features.title: Performance
features.description: Up to 450 HP for maximum traction and superior driving dynamics even at full load.

cta.title: Configure Your 4x4
cta.description: Build your perfect 4x4 expedition vehicle – customized for your specific requirements.
